basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old aspiring astronomer based in a small town in the Midwest. My passion for space and technology led me to pursue a degree in astrophysics, currently in my final year at university. I spend my evenings stargazing whenever the weather permits and am fascinated by the potential of satellite internet to connect remote regions. I work part-time at a local bookstore, which allows me to indulge in my love for science fiction. As a single individual, I’m exploring the nuances of adult life, often reflecting on existential thoughts. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings after my shifts or on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in astronomy and astrophysics stems from my academic studies, supplemented by countless hours of self-study through online courses and documentaries. I've developed a keen interest in satellite technologies and their societal impacts, especially since discovering Starlink.
